critical_code_review_comments: portfolio/engine.py optimize() is O(2^n) brute-force up to n<=15 opportunities; fallback greedy for larger. Fine for demo (n=5) but consider ILP or beam search if pipelines grow — currently gated correctly by max_brute.
portfolio_routes.py PUT /capacity does not validate equipment schema (name/total/committed) — malformed equipment would silently break capacity_limits later. Add pydantic model for equipment rows.
detect_conflicts overlaps deadline logic uses date.fromisoformat inside a loop with a broad except — a malformed deadline silently drops the pair. Consider logging.
Frontend Portfolio.jsx: resetScenario visible only after a scenario exists; good UX. No a11y label on sim-* number inputs; screen reader will read the raw testid.
